content:
### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 to 1024, 45):** Contains app icon/title (left) and utility/window controls (right).
*   **Sidebar (0, 45 to 280, 925):** Vertical navigation pane on the left.
    *   **Data Recovery Section:** Top group.
    *   **Advanced Features Section:** Middle group.
    *   **File Backup Section:** Bottom group.
*   **Main Content Area (280, 45 to 1024, 925):** White background container.
    *   **Header (310, 105 to 700, 155):** Page title and refresh icon.
    *   **Internal Drives Section (310, 195 to 850, 370):** Grid of drive cards (2 columns visible).
    *   **Specify Location Section (310, 405 to 750, 690):** List of location cards (2 columns visible).
    *   **Footer Bar (280, 835 to 1024, 925):** Help text (left), Primary CTA (right).
*   **Taskbar (0, 925 to 1024, 768):** Windows OS taskbar at the bottom.

### 2. TEXT
*   **Title Bar:** "EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free"
*   **Sidebar:**
    *   "Data Recovery"
    *   "Hardware Disk"
    *   "SD Card"
    *   "More Recovery Tools"
    *   "Advanced Features"
    *   "File Repair"
    *   "Lost Partition Rescue"
    *   "File Backup"
    *   "ChronoSnap Backup"
*   **Main Area:**
    *   "Select a location to search for lost data"
    *   "Internal drives (2)"
    *   "Windows(C:)"
    *   "30.96 GB/149.45 GB"
    *   "Temporary Storage(D:)"
    *   "146.12 GB/150 GB"
    *   "Specify a location"
    *   "Recycle Bin"
    *   "Desktop"
    *   "Select Folder"
    *   "Unable to find your hard drive?"
    *   "Search for Lost Data"

### 3. COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window/Sidebar BG: `#F5F9FF` (ESTIMATED - Light Blue/Grey)
    *   Main Content BG: `#FFFFFF` (ESTIMATED - White)
    *   Selected Sidebar Item: `#E6F0FF` (ESTIMATED - Light Blue)
    *   Selected Card Border/BG: `#2B7EF6` (ESTIMATED - Bright Blue)
    *   Taskbar: `#F3F3F3` (ESTIMATED)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Headings/Names): `#1F1F1F` (ESTIMATED - Near Black)
    *   Secondary Text (Subtext/Capacity): `#666666` or `#888888` (ESTIMATED - Grey)
    *   Sidebar Text (Unselected): `#333333` (ESTIMATED)
    *   Sidebar Text (Section Header): `#888888` (ESTIMATED - Lighter Grey)
*   **Accents:**
    *   Primary Button BG: `#287DFA` (ESTIMATED - Blue)
    *   Progress Bar Fill (C:): `#287DFA`
    *   Progress Bar Fill (D:): `#E0E0E0` (ESTIMATED - Light Grey, indicating fullness or just style)
    *   Success Checkmark: `#287DFA`

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Window Title:** Sans-Serif, ~11px, Regular.
*   **Page Title ("Select a location..."):** Sans-Serif (likely Segoe UI/Arial), ~20px, Semi-bold/Medium.
*   **Section Headers ("Internal drives...", "Specify a location"):** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Regular, Grey.
*   **Card Titles ("Windows(C:)", "Recycle Bin"):** Sans-Serif, ~15px, Medium.
*   **Card Details ("30.96 GB..."):** Sans-Serif, ~12px, Regular, Grey.
*   **Sidebar Items:** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Regular.
*   **Button Text:** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Medium, White.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~280px.
*   **Card Dimensions:** Width ~240px, Height ~110px (Drives), Height ~90px (Locations).
*   **Card Padding:** ~16px internal padding.
*   **Icon Size (Cards):** 48x48px or 64x64px (rendered area).
*   **Icon Size (Sidebar):** 24x24px.
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Cards: ~8px.
    *   Button: ~6px.
    *   Progress Bars: ~2px (pill shape).
*   **Gutter (Grid):** ~24px between cards horizontally and vertically.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Sidebar Item (Hardware Disk):** State = **Selected**. Indicator: Light blue background, blue left border strip (approx 3-4px), blue checkmark badge on right.
*   **Drive Card (Windows C:):** State = **Selected/Focused**. Indicator: Blue border (2px), blue checkmark circle in top-right corner.
*   **Drive Card (Temporary Storage D:):** State = **Normal**.
*   **Location Cards (Recycle Bin, Desktop, Select Folder):** State = **Normal**.
*   **Primary Button ("Search for Lost Data"):** State = **Normal** (Solid fill, white text). Style: Rectangular with rounded corners.
*   **Refresh Icon (next to title):** Circular arrow icon.
*   **Help Link ("Unable to find..."):** Text with a question mark icon/circle.

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, filled/solid style with subtle gradients or shading for depth (typical of modern Windows apps / Fluent Design influence).
*   **Sidebar Icons:**
    *   Hardware Disk: Blue window/grid icon.
    *   SD Card: Grey SD card icon.
    *   More Tools: Grey wrench/tools icon.
    *   File Repair: Grey folder with tool icon.
    *   Lost Partition: Grey lifebuoy/icon.
    *   ChronoSnap: Grey circular arrows/backup icon.
*   **Main Area Icons:**
    *   Windows(C:): Windows logo + Hard Drive graphic.
    *   Temporary Storage(D:): Generic silver HDD graphic.
    *   Recycle Bin: Grey bin with recycle arrows.
    *   Desktop: Grey monitor screen icon.
    *   Select Folder: Yellow/Grey folder icon.

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Initial / Selection Required**. The user is at the first step of the wizard ("Select a location"). No scanning is in progress yet. The default selection is "Hardware Disk" -> "Windows(C:)".
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot). The refresh icon suggests the list can be updated.
